notes: All historical values come from the company’s official five-year summaries and consolidated statements. FY2007–2010 uses published DKK values, not translated USD summary data; FY2011 onward uses published USD figures. A currency change is represented per year.

netIncome is A.P. Møller - Mærsk A/S share of total profit, including discontinued operations; revenue/operatingIncome are the continuing-operations scope of the corresponding published summary. Divestments of oil, tankers, drilling, retail and Svitzer materially change comparability. FY2016–2018 income and cash-flow figures are the restated history published in 2020; 2018 is presented as if IFRS16 had been implemented. FY2023 assets were restated in 2024.

totalEquity uses directly published equity attributable to the parent. Where only total group equity including minorities appears in the historical summary, the field is null rather than subtracting minority equity. totalDebt uses directly published Total borrowings and leases for FY2024–2025 and Total borrowings for FY2014–2015; those older figures exclude operating leases under the then applicable accounting standard.

cashAndEquivalents is the balance-sheet Cash and bank balances figure; bank overdrafts are separately deducted in the cash-flow reconciliation. capex is purchases of intangible assets and property, plant and equipment; the older summary line Cash flow used for capital expenditure includes divestments and is not substituted for gross purchases.

Historical dilutedEPS/ordinary dividends are the published per-share values in each source, including the issuer’s split-adjusted older comparatives in later summaries. The 2010 report’s DKK per-share figures predate the 2014 bonus-share issuance and are not manually adjusted. FY2016–2020 dilutedEPS is explicitly continuing-operations EPS; total attributable income has a different scope.

Dividend per share excludes special distributions where the source reports ordinary separately. Employees, where available, is the average employee count from the consolidated employee note; no estimated or backfilled headcount/shares were introduced.
